description: Ministry of Ports & Shipping - Amend to the Ex.Gaz.No. 2195/26 of 29th September 2020
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains an order under the Sri Lanka Ports Authority Act for the acquisition and transfer of specific land allotments (described in detailed schedules with survey plans, boundaries, and measurements) to the Sri Lanka Ports Authority for business purposes. The content focuses exclusively on land descriptions, boundaries, and property transfers, making it a clear example of a Land Gazette.
